**About The Role**
 You'll own the core AI systems that power Gamma: the models, prompts, and pipelines behind text, image, and layout generation. With over 1 million AI\-generated presentations and 6 million AI images created every day, this work operates at massive scale. Your job is to elevate quality, evaluate new frontier models, and push into new capabilities and modalities.
   

  

 This role is about productizing existing foundation models, not training new ones. You'll focus on prompting, evaluating, and fine\-tuning for maximum performance across Gamma's product surface. You'll also launch new modalities like voice and video, build the evaluation infrastructure to measure what "good" looks like, and own uptime, latency, and cost across our AI stack. You'll work closely with engineering and product to ship improvements that millions of users feel immediately.
   

  

 You'll thrive here if you're a tinkerer who loves pushing foundation models to their limits and you're equally comfortable writing prompts and writing production code. If you get excited about mixing prompt engineering with software engineering to unlock new AI capabilities, this is your role.
   

  

 Our team has a strong in\-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own Gamma's LLM and image prompts, measuring and continuously improving quality at scale across text, layout, and visual generation
* Develop complex prompts for new features using AI JSX, balancing creativity with reliability
* Build evaluation frameworks for prompts and models, combining quantitative metrics with qualitative feedback to create better test sets
* Drive the AI roadmap based on quality gaps, constantly evaluating new frontier models and methods
* Curate datasets for fine\-tuning open\-source models and launch new modalities like voice and video
* Own analytics, tracking, uptime, latency, and cost across Gamma's AI infrastructure


**What You'll Bring**
* Proven track record pushing foundation models to their limits, with hands\-on experience building and evaluating prompts at scale
* Proficiency in TypeScript and Python, with a software engineering foundation that lets you move fluidly between prompt engineering and production development
* Strong data instincts: experience writing evals, designing metrics, and translating qualitative feedback into measurable, actionable improvements
* Self\-sufficient in gathering and cleaning data to inform prompt improvements and model evaluations
* Experience with modern LLMs and image models such as Flux and Imagen (Nice to have)
* Familiarity with AI tooling like AI JSX for prompting and Braintrust for evaluations (Nice to have)


**Compensation Range**
 The base salary for this full\-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $180K \- $300K plus benefits \& equity.
   

  

*Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above.*

An overview of this role
As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes.
Some examples of our projects:
Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab
Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features
Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo
Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments
What you'll do
Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab.
Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps.
Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js.
Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes.
Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics.
Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results.
Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase.
Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes.
What you'll bring
Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows.
Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization.
A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release.
Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back.
Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates.
Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values.
Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling.
About the team
We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own.
